title: Identifying early domestic cattle from the Pre-Pottery Neolithic sites on the Middle Euphrates using sexual dimorphism
version: New Methods and the First Steps of Mammal Domestication, Oxbow Books, pp. 86–94. Author-posted version of the chapter.
lineage: Primary measurements of cattle bones, previously cited indirectly through Arbuckle and Kassebaum.

passages.note: Dja’de male bones show greater size reduction from earlier comparisons than females. The authors assign Dja’de samples to 8800–8300 cal BCE and infer incipient domestication.
